content:
**Per-change progress and an epic rollup, counted only from data actually present (#1199)**

What: every snapshot change row carries progress {done,total} from one countTasks (brain/scripts/lib/tasks-list.mjs), with missing, unreadable and no-items told apart and never 0/0; the card and SDD view say done / total and that it was read from the working tree, the drawer counts its HEAD text and says so; status/hierarchy-adapter.mjs exposes the ADR-0039 resolver shape over today's kind/parent and the closedIssues section, and lane-model childrenOf reads children instead of inverting parent; an epic shows closed / total direct children on its heading and in its drawer, with unknown counted apart and 'counting closed children…' while the closed lane is pending. Why: maintainer's manager view (#1199), on top of #1257's non-blocking lanes. Learned: a lane's complete state means a read landed, not that the cache is readable now, so the rollup counts only when the closed data is present (closedRead) and otherwise says closed children unknown with the reason; smoke on the real repo: epic #878 reads 11 / 31 children closed.
